cover.coreProposition: Causally aligned context and workspace checkpoints are necessary for evaluated long-horizon recovery, but accountable resumption also requires occurrence-bound authority and reconciliation of effects outside the snapshot boundary.
cover.visualMetaphor: Two aligned translucent state planes rewind together while a bright external trace remains beyond their boundary
cover.semanticObject: A bounded workspace frame with paired context and environment layers, an interrupted path and one non-rewindable outward trail
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with a calm dark field, one precise rollback boundary and a visibly persistent external trace
